title: Design: Clicking a deposit-held Bill To shows a red toast with Open Deposits
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new open work order for this test for customer B billed to customer A, with a $10.00 deposit taken on it and not reversed, so a work order bills a customer other than its own.
  • Start on the work order page.
  • Open the attached picture bt-p3-08-after-click.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Bill To value.
  2. Click Open Deposits in the toast.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A red error toast shows at the bottom right with a warning triangle and the deposit message over three lines.
  • A white "Open Deposits" button shows in the toast (the design also draws "Close").

Step 2:

  • Customer A's Deposits tab opens.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12307 (Story 5, Locked Bill To: invoiced and deposits)

  • S5-R5: “Clicking or tapping that field shows M1 as an error toast with an "Open Deposits" button.”
  • S5-R6: “"Open Deposits" opens the Deposits tab of the customer holding the largest share of the deposits.”
